Hi Sofia - great to meet you today. Appreciate the clear questions. Quick answers below and I attached a short PR guidance doc for your procurement team.

- Payment method: we support both card and PO for enterprise customers. For POs we require a signed MSA or purchase order referencing the MSA.
- Supplier ID: yes, for Coupa/Ariba you can add Redwood under our legal name (Redwood Inference, Inc.). I've attached a supplier information sheet (Tax ID, W9 equivalent, remittance address). If your system requires a specific supplier ID, we can provision one from our finance team - see note below.
- Contract language: we have standard MSA clauses covering data residency and audit logs. For any additional security language we can route to our Security & Compliance team; happy to provide SOC 2 evidence and logging details.

Next steps I recommend:
1) If you're going the PO path, please create a Purchase Requisition (PR) in Coupa/Ariba and reference this deal id: RWI-ACME-2026-Q4.
2) Attach the supplier sheet to the PR and request a supplier ID (if required by your catalog).
3) If Coupa/Ariba requires a special setup, ping your vendor onboarding team and copy me - I will coordinate with our finance ops.

I've looped in Aditya (sales engineer) to help with any technical artifacts procurement needs. I've also attached a one-page PR_Instructions_Coupa.pdf that walks through the fields we've seen required (supplier name, tax id, remittance address, billing contact, PO terms).

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134
